audience: small business owners and sales teams who run CRM and invoicing in Teamleader Focus

useCases.title: Find unpaid invoices and who owes you
useCases.text: The AI lists outstanding invoices with totals and due dates, filtered by customer or date range. It adds who owes the most and which invoices are past due.

useCases.title: Review open deals by pipeline phase
useCases.text: The AI lists deals by pipeline, phase, status or responsible user and reads value and probability. You get what is open per phase and which deals close soon.

useCases.title: Look up a company and its contacts
useCases.text: The AI finds a company by search term or VAT number and reads its addresses, responsible user and related contacts. You get the company details and related contacts in one answer.

useCases.title: Create a deal or task for a new lead
useCases.text: The AI creates a contact or company, then a deal in a chosen phase, or a task with a due date and work type. It can assign the task to a user.

useCases.title: Log time, notes and meetings
useCases.text: The AI records tracked time for a customer, adds a note such as a call summary, or puts a meeting on the calendar. You skip the manual entry.
